机制概述: Dravil has an Ice and a Steam Form, determined by which side of the arena he is on. His attacks change depending on which Form he is in, so use his mobility to set up the perfect attack!

效果.效果: Setup: Place the Ice Marker on the edge of the arena behind Dravil, and the Steam Marker on the edge of the arena in front of him.

Dravil’s Ice triggers activate if he is closer to the Ice Marker than the Opponent. Dravil’s Steam triggers activate if he is closer to the Steam Marker than the Opponent. (If there are Opponents on both sides of Dravil, he activates both kinds of triggers.)
